name: Ma Wen
source:
the Web executive.
His main clients are underworld organizations in the New Territories area.
He is the one who asked his younger brother Master Ma to teach fighting techniques at the Web assassin school.
He manages spiders such as Sui San and Kylin.
At first, he was skeptical of Yvet's plan to destroy the Web, but after she succeeded in her sniper plan, he became determined and asked 13K's Chung Long to help her.
